```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("xxx")

#Invoke the libraries of installed packages
library(rlang)
library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytree)
library(ggstar)
library(TDbook)
library(treeio)
library(data.table)

# load tr and dat from the TDbook package 
dat <- fread("Fig. S9A_dat.csv")
tr <- read.tree("Fig. S9A_dat.nwk" )

#Define the strain names
strains <- c("Brevundimonas sp. MF374", "Dyella japonica MF79","Pseudomonas simiae WCS417",
               "Rhodanobacter sp. R179", "Escherichia coli K12"
               )

# For the tip points
dat1 <- dat %>% select(c("ID", "Strain"))
dat1$Strain <- factor(dat1$Strain, levels=strains)
#Straincolors <- dat1[match(strains,dat1$Strain),Strain_colour]

# For the heatmap layer
dat2 <- dat %>% select(c("ID", "Function"))
dat2$Function<- factor(dat2$Function, levels=c("Energy transducer","Unknown"))

# For the strain group
dat3 <- dat %>% select(c("ID","Protein accession","Strain"))
dat3 <- aggregate(.~Strain, dat3, FUN=paste, collapse=",")
TonBs <- lapply(dat3$ID, function(x){unlist(strsplit(x,split=","))})
names(TonBs) <- dat3$Strain

tr2 <- groupOTU(tr, TonBs, "Strain")   #ID in tr should match with that in clades
Strain <- NULL
tr2$edge.length <- NULL

tr2$tip.label <- gsub("^'|'$", "", tr2$tip.label)   # remove leading/trailing '
tr2$tip.label <- gsub(" aa", "aa", tr2$tip.label)   # remove space before aa

setdiff(tr2$tip.label, dat1$ID)
setdiff(dat1$ID, tr2$tip.label)

#Define strain colors and function colors
Gemini_color<-c("#ff791d","#4A7C59", "#A52A2A","#17becf", "#9B766F")
Function_color<-c("#8A2BE2","#ffbf41")

colnames(dat1)[colnames(dat1) == "Strain"] <- "Strain_type"

#Run ggtree to make a phylogenetic tree
p <- ggtree(tr = tr2, layout = "fan", open.angle = 15, size = 0.2)

#Highlight TonB1 identified in this study
p$data$label_color <- ifelse(p$data$label == "TonB1 (239aa)", "highlight", "normal")

#Add tip labels 
p<-p+geom_tiplab(aes(color = label_color), size = 3.5, offset = 1.5,show.legend = FALSE) +
     scale_colour_manual(
         values = c("normal" = "black", "highlight" = "red"),
         guide = "none"
     ) +
     new_scale_colour() +
     theme(
         legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
         legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
     )

#Add strain colors and function colors
p2 <- p +
      geom_fruit(
          data = dat1,
          geom = geom_tile,
          mapping = aes(x = 1, y = ID, fill = Strain_type),
          width = 0.5,
          color = "white",
          pwidth = 0.015,
          offset = 0.04,alpha = 1
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Strain (TonB number)",
    values = Gemini_color,
    labels = c(
        expression(italic("Brevundimonas") ~ "sp. MF374 (4)"),
        expression(italic("Dyella japonica") ~ "MF79 (10)"),
        expression(italic("Pseudomonas simiae") ~ "WCS417 (8)"),
        expression(italic("Rhodanobacter") ~ "sp. R179 (10)"),
        expression(italic("Escherichia coli") ~ "K12 (1)")
    ),
    na.translate = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(
        keywidth = 0.8,
        keyheight = 0.8,
        order = 3
    )
) +

      ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +   # allow a second fill scale

      geom_fruit(
          data = dat2,
          geom = geom_tile,
          mapping = aes(x = 1, y = ID, fill = Function),
          width = 0.5,
          color = "white",
          pwidth = 0.03,
          offset = 0.04,
          alpha = 1
      ) +

      scale_fill_manual(
           name = "Function (TonB number)",
           values = Function_color,
           labels = c("Energy transducer (25)","Unknown (8)"),
           guide = guide_legend(
               keywidth = 0.8,
               keyheight = 0.8,
               order = 4
           )
      ) +
      xlim(0, max(p$data$x) + 4) +   # expand plotting area 
      theme(
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
           legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
           legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 15)   # move legend away from tree
      )+
geom_point(
    data = subset(p$data, label == "TonB1 (239aa)"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "red",
    size = 3)

p2

#Highlight clades
p3<-p2 +
geom_hilight(node = 35, fill = "#a1d99b", alpha = 0.3) +
geom_hilight(node = 48, fill = "red", alpha = 0.3)

p3

#Save the phylogenetic tree as a tiff file
ggsave("Fig. S9A.tif", plot = p3, width = 10, height = 6.5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff",compression = "lzw")

#Save the phylogenetic tree as a svg file
library(svglite)
ggsave("Fig. S9A.svg", plot = p3, width = 10, height = 6.5, device = "svg")

```
